One is a red Nano or Mini model in the bottom left with a glowing red click wheel. White earphone cables are tangled in the background.

The red click wheel glows with an unnatural, uniform neon intensity that doesn't match typical LED behavior. The casing edges around it seem slightly soft or melted into the background.
The white earphone cables blend indistinctly into the white casing of the top-right iPod and the background surface, lacking clear boundary separation.
The rectangular shape shows slight warping; the parallel lines of the device edges do not remain perfectly straight, suggesting minor geometric instability.
